acceptance: A non-ASCII dirty file is stashed and the tree is clean
An untracked record is archived and staged
A symlinked module dir filters correctly
fix: Use git -z output (NUL-separated, no quoting) for (1) and (4). Stage both old and new paths, or skip never-committed records, for (2). EvalSymlinks moduleDir for (3). Red test first for each.

summary: (1) MEDIUM: core/boot_preflight.go porcelainPaths does not unquote C-quoted paths when core.quotePath is on, so é.go comes back escaped. QuarantineDirtyTree then reports stashed=true while the file stays dirty, or fails after the stash was saved. (2) MEDIUM: explanationdocs ArchiveUnpublishedContinuationRecords renames an untracked, never-committed record first; then git add -A -- <old path> fails with pathspec did not match, so the record is moved but unstaged. (3) LOW: core buildTagVisiblePackages fails open when moduleDir goes through a symlink (/var to /private/var). (4) LOW: repostate.TrackedTree TrimSpace strips spaces that belong to filenames. (5) Observation: explanationdocs.currentDiffState digests a plain non-repo subdirectory as a gitlink of the parent HEAD.
title: Path handling defects found by coverage backfill A (quoted paths, untracked archive, symlinked module, trimmed names) (lane part)
